title: Carry failed check output into retry and referenced-job briefs
summary: The reader brief for 'try again on <job>' carries the rejected job's findings and reasons but not why its checks failed. Make `carry` in reading.rs also include each failed check's name, command, exit code and recorded output tail, redacted and size-bounded.

defaults_applied.how: Add tests for carrying failed-check output and for redaction.
One focused change in carry(), no new structs.
Carried check output is redacted like other carried text.
Located the gap in reading.rs carry() from the repository rather than asking.

assumptions: 'Retries' means the reader brief for 'try again on <job>' (and referenced jobs), which currently carries only findings and reasons, not the failed CheckRun.output_tail stored in verification.json.
Only failed checks' output is added; the producer brief is not changed.
Output is truncated to a modest cap (the stored output_tail is already a tail).

acceptance_criteria.text: `carry` in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs adds, for each check in the carried job's final verification with passed == false, an entry naming the check, its command, exit code, and its output_tail, placed in EarlierAttempt.findings after the findings and reasons.
Passing checks contribute nothing; a verification with no failed checks yields the same findings as before.
The check output goes through the same redactor as the other carried text (redact_all), and is bounded in size so one noisy check cannot bloat the reader brief.
Both a retried job (earlier_attempt) and a job referenced by id (referenced_jobs) carry the failed-check output, since both use `carry`; the brief wording in briefs.rs still labels it as data.

A new unit or lifecycle test builds a rejected job whose verification has a failed check with a distinctive output_tail, and asserts the reader brief for 'try again on <job>' contains that output and the check name, and omits output of a passing check. Run `cargo test`.
A test shows a secret-shaped string in the check output is redacted in the carried text. Run `cargo test`.

out_of_scope: Changing what verification.json records for checks
Changing the producer or verifier briefs
Changing retry detection or the 'try again on' syntax
